name: IQO Quantum
author: International Quantum Olympiad (QAIF)
description: International science-olympiad identity for the IQO: transparent header over a full-bleed Bloch-sphere hero, oversized Space Grotesk display type, numbered full-width section bands, glass/outline cards with orbital marks, leaf-shaped buttons, big-wordmark footer. Dark-first with a polished light palette; logo and type pairing selectable.
